label: mosshell faint
brief: One creature on a neutral stage beside a 1.80 m human ruler: standing, then the faint at three moments (going down, mid, the end pose). Judge the creature's model and material as the game's real look - identity, silhouette, appeal, surface and colour, proportion and scale against the ruler - and whether the faint reads clearly as knocked out, distinct from standing.
